name: LostEcplipsesNarration4
assigned_message:
We are detecting scanning activity from enemy ships in the surrounding area. It's crucial to maintain a low level of detectability. If we make too much noise, they will send fighters for reconnaissance, and we'll be forced into battles that we aren't prepared for right now.
It is necessary to use low-noise production systems for now. Additionally, it is important to monitor the detectability value and bring it back to normal levels when it exceeds the safety threshold.
